Handheld footage from a village-edge chalet balcony, high vantage looking up a steep snowy slope where the avalanche is descending into the buildings just below it; the slope and the avalanche fill the upper half of the frame, the nearest buildings and a corner of the railing fill the lower half; slight hand shake, the camera stays fixed, tilting slightly and never descending; one continuous shot, no zoom, no cuts. Setting: steep forested slopes, tall narrow wooden houses with heavy roofs, heavy overcast sky. Bystanders wear winter civilian clothes; raw natural light, no hazmat suits. No readable signs, text or flags.
